---
title: "Appendices 1–5 · Entity Load Assessments"
---

Appendices 1–5 present the per-entity, per-facility allocation assessment for each bay segment over
the 2022–2025 Reasonable Assurance period. For each entity the table lists the facility (point-source
discharge or MS4), its allocation (percent of remaining load, where applicable, and TMDL-equivalent
tons/yr), and the mean annual **effective load** over 2022–2025, with an allocation status. Each table
is rendered natively from a per-segment CSV in `data/`.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Source.** These are the "Assessment" tables generated by the TBEP
[`load-reporting`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/load-reporting) pipeline
(`show_aaassess()`, from `data/aa2225.RData`) — the same tables published at
<https://loads.tbep.org/drafttables.html> — covering **2022–2025**. A facility whose effective load
is at or below its allocated tons is *within allocation*; one above is flagged *exceeds allocation*.
Per entity, the **Total** row compares the entity's combined effective load to its combined allocation.
:::

```{r}
#| label: appendix-tables
#| results: asis
library(flextable)
library(here)

appx <- read.csv(here("data", "appendix_summary.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

render_appendix <- function(n, segment, slug, tmdl) {
  dat <- read.csv(here("data", paste0(slug, ".csv")), check.names = FALSE)
  for (col in names(dat)) dat[[col]][is.na(dat[[col]])] <- ""

  cat(sprintf("\n\n## Appendix %d. %s allocation assessment, 2022–2025\n\n", n, segment))
  cat(sprintf(paste0("Segment TMDL: **%s tons/yr**. Allocation shown as percent of remaining load ",
                     "(MS4 / nonpoint) and TMDL-equivalent tons/yr; effective load is the mean annual ",
                     "hydrologically-normalized TN load, 2022–2025, in tons/yr.\n\n"),
              format(tmdl, big.mark = ",")))

  ft <- flextable(dat)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, Entity = "Entity", Facility = "Facility",
                          Alloc_pct = "Alloc. %", Alloc_tons = "Allocated (tons/yr)",
                          Effective_load_tn = "Effective load (tons/yr)", Status = "Status")
  ft <- merge_v(ft, j = "Entity")
  ft <- bg(ft, bg = "#BDD7EE", part = "header")
  ft <- bold(ft, j = "Entity", part = "body")
  ft <- bold(ft, i = ~ Facility == "Total", part = "body")
  ft <- align(ft, j = c("Alloc_pct","Alloc_tons","Effective_load_tn"), align = "right", part = "all")
  st <- which(names(dat) == "Status")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {
    s <- dat$Status[i]
    if (s == "Within allocation") ft <- bg(ft, i = i, j = st, bg = "#A9D08E", part = "body")
    else if (s == "Exceeds allocation") ft <- bg(ft, i = i, j = st, bg = "#F4B183", part = "body")
  }
  ft <- valign(ft, j = "Entity", valign = "top", part = "body")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 8, part = "all")
  ft <- border_outer(ft); ft <- border_inner_h(ft, part = "body")
  ft <- set_table_properties(ft, layout = "autofit", width = 1)
  flextable_to_rmd(ft)
  cat("\n\n")
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(appx))) {
  r <- appx[i, ]
  render_appendix(r$appendix, r$segment, r$slug, r$tmdl)
}
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
An "exceeds allocation" status for an individual facility does **not** by itself indicate a
segment-level reasonable-assurance failure. Under the NMC framework (Tables 2–6, Section 2.d),
entity/facility exceedances are evaluated (NMC Actions 4–5) only when a segment's chlorophyll-*a*
threshold is not met, and entity-generated reductions are retained as indefinite credits (2009 RA
Addendum §IX.D). All segments met their chlorophyll-*a* thresholds over 2022–2026.
:::

::: {.provenance}
**Appendices 1–5:** TBEP [`load-reporting`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/load-reporting) "Assessment"
outputs (`drafttables.qmd` → `show_aaassess()`, `data/aa2225.RData`), 2022–2025. Allocation percentages
and TMDL-equivalent loads correspond to **Tables 10–14** (*Action Plan & Allocation Tables* chapter).
:::
